Name: lunakatt's DCBurger style portraits for Life Cycle NPCs
Author: lunakatt
Description:
[size=4]lunakatt's DCBurger Style Portraits for Life Cycle - Rival Heart Events

[size=3]Another portrait mod in the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's High Res Portrait Mod[/url] for NPCs from the lovely nraittanna's mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6200]Life Cycle - Rival Heart Events[/url]! [/size]
[/size]

[size=3]Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=4][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6200]Life Cycle - Rival Heart Events[/url][/size][/size]

Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed
2. Extract the CP version of this mod into your mods directory
3. Run the game using SMAPI

[b][size=4]Go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13599?tab=description]HD Portraits Patches for PyTK[/url] by purplexpresso to get a patch for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] :D
[/size][/b]Thank you to purplexpresso, go show them some love on their mod page!

As always first thanks to DCBurger! <3
Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54395902]nnraittanna[/url] for your permission to make portraits for your mod and for making the mod itself! Life Cycle is one of my favourite SDV mods please go show them some love!
Psst, go check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120691188]OrangePie[/url]'s portrait mods!

Check out my Stardew Valley Expanded portraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9029]here[/url]!
And a matchy matchy mod for the NPC Wilford [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9141]here[/url]!
And one for the NPC Denver [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9210]here[/url]!


If you'd like, consider buying me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lunakatt]Ko-fi[/url]!
